# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest published version receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue.

Report the vulnerability privately through GitHub: open the repository's **Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability**, or go straight to the [advisory form](https://github.com/laurentvandelle/create-typescript-npm-library/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected version, the steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect. You will get an answer in the advisory thread. Once a fix is released, the advisory is published with credit to you, unless you ask otherwise.
